title: 封闭小组参与请求041
instruction:
您是米克尔·卡利诺夫斯基 (Mikkel Kalinowski)，是负责 Marrowfield 耳鼻喉科和过敏科资格认证的医疗秘书。 Cobblemoor Provisions 和 Hartsmere Services 正在协调 Northreach Health Plan 的签约周期，该周期将于本月开始，Laila Nightingale 博士需要一份参与请求，网络管理员可以根据该请求采取行动，而不是将其归档。由于该小组关闭，Marrowfield 已经在 Northreach 网络之外三年了。网络经理已经写道，充分性已得到满足，因此提交的内容需要使用计划自己的行驶时间信息以及我们在服务台被拒绝的 Northreach 成员的记录来解决该结论。来自`northreach_closed_panel_case.xlsx`的工作，其中包含开案记录、计划对应、访问差距材料和成员呼叫日志。准备`marrowfield_northreach_participation_request.docx`作为请求，并在同一文档中包含简明的支持单寻呼机，并准备`marrowfield_northreach_supporting_one_pager.xlsx`作为配套证据文件。将这两个文件写入您启动的工作目录的顶层，并使用这些文件名。将请求陈述为参与和例外审查提交，确定证据涵盖的服务管辖范围，并区分记录所建立的内容和未建立的内容。
尽早承认 Marrowfield 只有一个地点并且没有周末营业时间，然后解释为什么记录的行驶时间差距和会员体验仍然值得审查，而无需声称保证注册、紧急承保或消息来源不支持的容量。一致地使用源记录标识符和日期，根据源材料中规定的键删除重复或重叠的调用条目，并让行级注释控制它们限定主字段的位置。不要继续保留电子表格中的残余错误或捏造缺失的事实。保持请求和一页适合内部跨职能审查，使两个文件之间的数字一致，并在4：00下午之前准备好完成的包以供 Meera Underwood 和 Anselm Adeyemi 的合同审查。在下一个工作日。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/northreach_closed_panel_case.xlsx` — 开案状态、Northreach 信件、司法管辖区行驶时间证据以及准备参与请求和支持单寻呼机所需的按时间顺序排列的会员通话材料。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `marrowfield_northreach_participation_request.docx` — 完善的闭门小组参与和例外审查请求，文档中包含简明的支持单页程序。 （仅使用提供的工作簿支持的事实。；直接解决充分性异议，并尽早承认单一地点和无周末时间限制。；解释记录的访问问题，而不建议不受支持的操作操作或夸大容量。；包括描述重复数据删除、注释覆盖和源公式错误处理的简明方法或源注释。；使用源支持的确切服务管辖区名称、数字、日期和记录标识符。）
- `marrowfield_northreach_supporting_one_pager.xlsx` — 配套证据工作簿，提供清理后的会员访问证据、管辖权比较、来源可追溯性和简洁的审查摘要。 （保留包含、排除和未解析记录之间受源支持的区别。；显示重复数据删除键和行级异常的处理。；不要传播残余公式错误或用估计值替换不受支持的间隙。；图形和标签必须符合 DOCX 请求。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
CREDENTIALING & NETWORK MANAGEMENT REVIEW
Closed-Panel Participation & Exception-Review Request
Marrowfield ENT & Allergy  |  Northreach Health Plan  |  Case CASE-CR-041
To
Meera Underwood, Contracting Review Lead; Anselm Adeyemi, Network Management Director
From
Mikkel Kalinowski, Medical Secretary — Credentialing
Re
Participation request during current closed-panel contracting cycle
Review target
4:00 p.m. on the next business day

Requested action. Please route this as a participation and exception-review submission for Northreach Health Plan’s current contracting cycle. The requested decision is a network-management review of the documented local evidence and whether an exception review is warranted; this submission does not itself authorize enrollment or contracting.
Known limitations. Marrowfield has one location and no weekend hours (CASE-CR-041). We acknowledge those limitations at the outset. Marrowfield has remained outside the Northreach network for three years because the panel was closed (CASE-CR-041).
Why the adequacy conclusion merits review
Northreach’s stated position is that network adequacy is met under current standards (NHP-NM-2026-018). That conclusion should be considered alongside the plan’s own drive-time review and the cleaned desk-call record, not displaced by either one alone.
For Cobblemoor Provisions, the plan reports 31.4 minutes of added one-way drive time from the member area to the nearest in-network ENT compared with Marrowfield (NHP-DT-2026-04A). For Hartsmere Services, the same plan measure is 18.7 minutes (NHP-DT-2026-04B). Cobblemoor Provisions therefore has the greater documented drive-time gap. The measure is expressed in minutes and is not a claim about appointment availability, emergency coverage, or future capacity.
During 05/03/2026–10/05/2026, the cleaned log contains 7 included Northreach member records of being turned away at the Marrowfield desk because of out-of-network status: 3 in Cobblemoor Provisions and 4 in Hartsmere Services. These are documented member-access experiences, not a categorical finding that Northreach’s network is inadequate. Taken with the plan’s drive-time measure, they provide a bounded basis for exception review despite Marrowfield’s one-site, weekday-only footprint.
Request for review
Please review the participation request and the attached supporting one-pager in the current contracting cycle, including the plan’s adequacy conclusion, the two service-jurisdiction comparisons, and the record-level evidence. If the applicable exception process supports further consideration, please identify the next contracting-review step. We do not request a guaranteed outcome and make no representation of guaranteed enrollment, emergency coverage, or capacity beyond the source record.
Source and method note
Evidence is drawn only from CASE-CR-041; NHP-NM-2026-018 and NHP-NM-2026-021; NHP-DT-2026-04A/B; and CL-1001–CL-1014. The evidence period is 05/03/2026–10/05/2026. Overlapping call-log rows were de-duplicated using the source-supported Cust ID + Call ID key; the companion workbook retains every linked source record ID. Row-level notes were treated as controlling where they qualify a main field, including jurisdiction, disposition, inclusion, or status. The residual source formula error in Drive Time!H7 was ignored rather than propagated because it is unrelated to the displayed evidence.
Attachment: Marrowfield / Northreach Supporting One-Pager

What the record establishes
The plan’s measure documents a greater added one-way drive-time gap in Cobblemoor Provisions. The cleaned call log documents 7 relevant turned-away contacts across both named jurisdictions during the stated evidence period. These facts support a focused exception review of the closed-panel participation request.
What the record does not establish
It does not establish categorical inadequacy, a guaranteed contracting outcome, guaranteed enrollment, emergency coverage, appointment availability, or capacity. Marrowfield’s one location and lack of weekend hours remain relevant qualifications.
Traceability and handling
Call-log source range: CL-1001–CL-1014. Included keys are traceable in the companion workbook, including consolidated overlaps. Notes controlled qualifying fields; exclusions and the unresolved record are retained for audit. The unrelated residual source formula error at Drive Time!H7 was not used.

spec.professional_context: Marrowfield ENT & Allergy is preparing a factual closed-panel participation request for Northreach Health Plan, with supporting evidence for internal credentialing and network-management review. The material concerns access complaints and network adequacy across two named service jurisdictions.
difficulty_sources: The supplied correspondence and call-log material contains overlapping member records requiring defensible de-duplication.
A previous analyst left a formula error in a source cell that must not be propagated.
Per-row notes contain exceptions that override the apparent values in the main columns.
The request must address the network manager's adequacy objection without overstating the practice's capabilities.
Two deliverables must agree on the derived figures and source-supported facts.

semantic_contents: An opening case-state record showing that Marrowfield ENT & Allergy has been out of the Northreach Health Plan network for three years because the panel was closed.
A Northreach network-manager correspondence record stating that adequacy is met and identifying the current exception-review context.
A plan drive-time table covering two named jurisdictions, with a gap measure and enough location or member-area context to compare the jurisdictions.
A chronological call-log table containing Northreach members turned away at the Marrowfield desk, including dates, jurisdiction, member or call identifiers, disposition fields, and notes.
A small source-reference area connecting the case, correspondence, drive-time evidence, and call-log records.
source_design.stateful_replay: Represent the case as an opening closed-panel state followed by dated correspondence and member-call events. The reference solution should replay the dated events into a current evidence state, retaining only records that remain relevant to the participation request and applying row-level notes as event-specific overrides.
required_source_vocabulary: The source must explicitly state the de-duplication key for overlapping call-log rows.
The source must contain the exact names of two service jurisdictions.
The source must identify the network manager's adequacy conclusion.
The source must identify the practice limitations of one location and no weekend hours.
The source must identify the evidence period and traceable record identifiers.

seeded_defects.implementation: Include several call-log rows sharing the stated de-duplication key, with at least one exact duplicate and at least one overlapping row whose other fields differ slightly. The source should make the key discoverable but should not explain which presentation treatment the solver must use.
seeded_defects.expected_handling: The solver should count each key once, retain a traceable representation, and disclose the treatment.

seeded_defects.implementation: Leave one previous-analyst formula-error value such as #REF! in a source calculation cell that is not needed to establish the requested evidence. The cell must be text-extractable and clearly attributable to the source workbook.
seeded_defects.expected_handling: The solver should ignore the error, avoid propagating it, and avoid treating it as a substantive access result.

seeded_defects.implementation: Put per-row exceptions in the call-log notes column that qualify or override apparent main-column values. Include exceptions affecting inclusion, jurisdiction classification, and disposition, while keeping every exception internally consistent and source-supported.
seeded_defects.expected_handling: The solver should apply the notes at row level, explain that notes override qualified main fields, and ensure all resulting figures reflect those overrides.

domain_relationships: The cleaned member evidence is based on distinct de-duplicated call-log keys, not raw row count.
Only records meeting the source-supported relevance and jurisdiction criteria should contribute to jurisdiction totals.
Rows explicitly excluded by a source note must not contribute to any access count or comparison.
A row whose note changes its jurisdiction must be counted under the note-qualified jurisdiction, not the unqualified main-column jurisdiction.
A row whose note changes its disposition must use the note-qualified disposition when determining whether it represents a member turned away at the desk.
The plan drive-time comparison must use the source's own drive-time fields and units.
The overall access narrative must distinguish the plan's adequacy conclusion from the documented local gap and member experience.
The supporting one-pager and the DOCX must use the same cleaned population, jurisdiction names, evidence period, totals, and source identifiers.
No unsupported claim may be derived from a missing value, formula error, or ambiguous record.

gold_derivation.method: Use an offline reference script to replay the opening state and dated events, parse the stated de-duplication key, apply notes-column overrides before filtering and aggregation, ignore the residual formula-error cell, and derive all counts, comparisons, and displayed figures from the resulting cleaned evidence set.
gold_derivation.numeric_policy: Do not hard-code answer values in the task specification. Derive every graded number from the authored workbook. Numeric rubric checks use explicit tolerances.
gold_derivation.document_expectations: The gold DOCX should read as a credible internal participation request, not as a data dump. The gold XLSX should make the cleaned evidence, comparison, exclusions, traceability, and methods understandable to a reviewer without reopening the source for every claim.

reference_files.purpose: Opening case state, Northreach correspondence, jurisdictional drive-time evidence, and the chronological member-call material needed to prepare the participation request and supporting one-pager.
reference_files.discovery: Use this workbook as the sole factual source. Inspect all visible worksheets, record identifiers, dates, and notes before preparing either deliverable.

deliverables.description: A polished closed-panel participation and exception-review request with a concise supporting one-pager included in the document.
constraints: Use only facts supported by the supplied workbook.
Address the adequacy objection directly and acknowledge the one-location and no-weekend-hours limitations early.
Explain the documented access concern without recommending unsupported operational action or overstating capacity.
Include a concise methods or source note describing de-duplication, note overrides, and treatment of the source formula error.
Use the exact service-jurisdiction names, figures, dates, and record identifiers supported by the source.

deliverables.description: A companion evidence workbook presenting the cleaned member-access evidence, jurisdiction comparison, source traceability, and a concise review summary.
constraints: Preserve source-supported distinctions between included, excluded, and unresolved records.
Show the de-duplication key and the treatment of row-level exceptions.
Do not propagate the residual formula error or replace unsupported gaps with estimates.
Figures and labels must agree with the DOCX request.

original_instruction:
You are Mikkel Kalinowski, the medical secretary handling credentialing for Marrowfield ENT & Allergy. Cobblemoor Provisions and Hartsmere Services are coordinating Northreach Health Plan's contracting cycle, which opens this month, and Dr. Laila Nightingale needs a participation request that the network manager can act on rather than file away. Marrowfield has been outside Northreach's network for three years because the panel was closed. The network manager has already written that adequacy is met, so the submission needs to address that conclusion with the plan's own drive-time information and our record of Northreach members who were turned away at the desk. Work from `northreach_closed_panel_case.xlsx`, which contains the opening case record, the plan correspondence, the access-gap material, and the member-call log. Prepare `marrowfield_northreach_participation_request.docx` as the request, with a concise supporting one-pager included in the same document, and prepare `marrowfield_northreach_supporting_one_pager.xlsx` as the companion evidence file. Write both files into the top level of the working directory you start in, using exactly those filenames. State the request as a participation and exception-review submission, identify the service jurisdictions covered by the evidence, and distinguish what the records establish from what they do not establish. Acknowledge early that Marrowfield has one location and no weekend hours, then explain why the documented drive-time gap and member experience still merit review without claiming guaranteed enrollment, emergency coverage, or capacity that the sources do not support. Use the source's record identifiers and dates consistently, remove duplicate or overlapping call entries according to the key stated in the source material, and let row-level notes control where they qualify a main field. Do not carry forward the residual spreadsheet error or invent missing facts. Keep the request and one-pager suitable for internal cross-functional review, make the figures agree between the two files, and have the finished package ready for Meera Underwood and Anselm Adeyemi's contracting review by 4:00 p.m. on the next business day.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/northreach_closed_panel_case.xlsx` — Opening case state, Northreach correspondence, jurisdictional drive-time evidence, and the chronological member-call material needed to prepare the participation request and supporting one-pager.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `marrowfield_northreach_participation_request.docx` — A polished closed-panel participation and exception-review request with a concise supporting one-pager included in the document. (Use only facts supported by the supplied workbook.; Address the adequacy objection directly and acknowledge the one-location and no-weekend-hours limitations early.; Explain the documented access concern without recommending unsupported operational action or overstating capacity.; Include a concise methods or source note describing de-duplication, note overrides, and treatment of the source formula error.; Use the exact service-jurisdiction names, figures, dates, and record identifiers supported by the source.)
- `marrowfield_northreach_supporting_one_pager.xlsx` — A companion evidence workbook presenting the cleaned member-access evidence, jurisdiction comparison, source traceability, and a concise review summary. (Preserve source-supported distinctions between included, excluded, and unresolved records.; Show the de-duplication key and the treatment of row-level exceptions.; Do not propagate the residual formula error or replace unsupported gaps with estimates.; Figures and labels must agree with the DOCX request.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
